verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's changelog documents first-party outbound webhooks with named event types (backup.succeeded, backup.failed). Users can also set an Authorization header on webhook delivery, so a programmatic consumer can subscribe to and authenticate incoming events. missing for 10: a full webhook event catalog and registration/API docs, delivery semantics (retries, signing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: We've added backup.succeeded and backup.failed webhook events. You'll get notified when a backup finishes, whether it worked or not.
You can now set an Authorization header on webhooks.
